description: This file provides platform-specific functions for firmware upgrade and configuration copying for a device based on the microchipsw platform, specifically handling different board names such as ev23x71a and tactical-1000. It contains functions to check image validity, perform upgrades, and copy configurations, utilizing external commands and scripts.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the validity of the firmware image; currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade based on the board name, delegating to eMMC or default upgrade methods.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies firmware configuration data for specific boards.
